messages:
raj: incident-bot fired: Pager P-84271 for dedicated-eu-proxy-cpu (threshold: 80%)
incident-bot: [automated] Pager P-84271 -> channel #eng-oncall - severity: P2 - metric: proxy_cpu (podset=d-ed-eu-proxy)
alex: acked on PD :handshake: I got it
mike-sre: looking. I see a short spike across the proxy pool at 18:12:02, ~30s window. graph: https://graf.redwood/proxy/cpu?from=18:11:30&to=18:13:00
jane-pm: any customer-facing 5xxs or elevated error rates?
alex: checking logs... `grep error /var/log/proxy/*.log | tail -n 50` - no new 5xxs, a few 429s from internal canary traffic
raj: is this the canary rollout we scheduled earlier?
mike-sre: yeah, canary load test kicked off at 18:10. looks correlated. CPU returned to baseline by 18:12:40
oname: incident-bot follow-up: Pager P-84271 auto-resolve timer started (120s)
alex: I'm going to silence PD for the next 10m to avoid noise while we confirm - silencing now
pagerduty: Alert P-84271 silenced by alex for 10m (note: investigating correlated canary)
oname: incident-bot: P-84271 auto-resolved at 18:13:20 (duration: ~78s) :white_check_mark:
raj: ok good. No customer impact per logs and traces. I'll mark as noise from scheduled canary.
jane-pm: please add a short incident note so support teams see it if they lookup the PD alert
alex: adding note -> `cause: scheduled canary load test; transient proxy cpu spike; no 5xxs or customer impact; pd auto-resolved`
mike-sre: quick paste of relevant snippet: ```
2026-03-14T18:11:58 proxy-01 cpu=86% canary-tag=true
2026-03-14T18:12:05 proxy-03 cpu=81% canary-tag=true
2026-03-14T18:12:32 proxy-02 cpu=62% canary-tag=false
```
raj: should we widen alerting composite to require sustained 2min above threshold before paging? This is causing flappy PD pages during short canaries
jane-pm: +1 on reducing noise, but check latency SLO fallout first. We don't want to hide real regressions
alex: I'll open a quick follow-up ticket to eng-infra: `ENGINFRA-1142` - propose: require 60s sustained + 2 samples above 80% OR add canary-tag suppression rule
mike-sre: temporary mitigation: add silence rule for scheduled canary time windows (we already run them in low-load window)
oname: oncall-bot: handoff reminder -> if this reoccurs in next 30m escalate to pg oncall (sam)
raj: ack. tagging @sam in case it gets noisier later
sam:  (joined) saw the PD page come through, thanks for the quick triage. If we get more than 2 within 1h we should treat as potential regression
alex: noted. I'll leave the PD silence and monitor dashboards for the next 30m.
jane-pm: customer comms not needed for now. filing a short post-event note in the incident tracker: `No customer impact; noise from scheduled canary; recommend alert tuning.`
raj: closing thread unless we see another page. nice fast resolution team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed (auto-resolve log attached).
